data.content:
卡芙卡
卡芙卡is a person involved in a conversation about the mysterious individual and Black Tower.<SEP>卡芙卡is a member of the Star Hunters who arrives at the space station and takes over the operation.<SEP>卡芙卡is a character who comments on the weakness of the anti-matter legion and identifies various geniuses.

黑塔
黑塔is a person mentioned, appears young despite being famous over a hundred years ago during the previous Amber Era.<SEP>黑塔is a genius who was targeted by银狼.

天才俱乐部
The Genius Society is an organization that黑塔is a member of.<SEP>天才俱乐部is an organization for geniuses, potentially including the white-bearded old man.

博识尊
博识尊is the Aeon of Erudition, and黑塔is an Emanator of博识尊.<SEP>博识尊is a star god that may have been created by赞达尔.

智识
智识is a Path associated with博识尊.

琥珀纪
Amber Era is a unit of time mentioned, during which黑塔was already famous.

联盟
The Alliance is a faction mentioned, known for long-lived beings.

？？？
An unidentified person conversing with卡芙卡, providing information about黑塔and the Genius Society.

反物质军团
反物质军团is an organization that invaded the space station two system hours ago, causing explosions and system paralysis.<SEP>The anti-matter legion is a force that has become weak according to卡芙卡.

艾利欧
艾利欧is a member of the Star Hunters known for foreseeing the future and writing "scripts" for the team's actions.<SEP>艾利欧is a person who took interest in银狼after her actions against螺丝咕姆.

空间站
空间站is the location where the events take place, recently attacked by the Antimatter Legion.<SEP>The space station is the internal location that characters successfully entered after passing through the corridor.

令使
An Emanator is a powerful being chosen by an Aeon, such as黑塔being an Emanator of博识尊.

「智识」
The Path of Erudition, associated with the Aeon博识尊.

红头发的站长
红头发的站长is the station master with red hair who orders evacuation procedures.

白色头发的少年
白色头发的少年is a character with white hair who reacts to the danger.

纠缠之缘的转世
纠缠之缘的转世is a character who warns others to be careful during the chaos.

银狼
银狼is the unnamed speaker ("？？？") talking to Kafka, a Star Hunter who finds previous missions boring and seeks enjoyment.<SEP>银狼is a character who cracked螺丝咕姆's program and is identified by卡芙卡as a target of艾利欧.

赞达尔
赞达尔•壹•桑原is historically the first genius and is rumored to have created博识尊.

寂静领主
寂静领主is another name for波尔卡•卡卡目, a person with an empty face who destroyed her own images across the universe.

波尔卡·卡卡目
波尔卡·卡卡目is the寂静领主, known for destroying her own portraits and sculptures.

螺丝咕姆
螺丝咕姆is a genius and an old opponent of银狼.

命运的奴隶
命运的奴隶is a title that银狼ironically applies to herself.

星穹列车
星穹列车is a group that卡芙卡intends to delay with the anti-matter legion.

末日兽
末日兽is a creature brought in to assist in delaying星穹列车.

赞达尔·壹·桑原
赞达尔·壹·桑原is the historically first genius and a member of the genius club, known for possibly creating博识尊.

白胡子老头儿
The white-bearded old man is speculated to be a member of the天才俱乐部.
